description:
The Pega Integration Developer will review and analyze the application architecture of the current Pegasystem implementation, technical integration with internal/external systems and technical service levels for a group of technologies. Support the development of SDLC deliverables including solution architecure document, interface control documents, detailed design documents etc. The consultant will work with the team and client to document functional designs and work alongside the build team to capture design detail in the SDLC deliverables. The consultant will configure the system and support the build where necessary.


 3+ years of experience using Pegasystems framework and open standards (SOAP, REST or JMS) for systems integration using web services and service interfaces
Demonstrated understanding of Pega methodologies (Agile Scrum preferred)
Experience with full lifecycle Pega implementations (preferably Pega 7)
Understanding of various Pega Rules required. (Ex: UI, Activities and Flows, Declaratives, Decision, Validation, Reports, Correspondences)
Knowledge of Application Security concepts, Integration and their error handling required


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
